step1_analysis.description: A two-stage differential ring oscillator delay cell with phase interpolation tuning. It uses cross-coupled NMOS pairs (XM1/2, XM3/4) for negative resistance and injection NMOS pairs (XM5/6, XM7/8) to couple the stages, enforcing quadrature oscillation.

paper_reference.title: A 2-V 1.8-GHz Fully Integrated CMOS Dual-Loop Frequency Synthesizer

oscillation_frequency.description: Operating frequency of the oscillator for a given bias current.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay per stage ~ R_load * C_load. Assuming R=500 ohm, C_parasitic=26fF, C_added=100fF, Td=63ps. Freq = 1/(4*Td) = 4 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sky130 (130nm) is significantly faster than the original 0.5um process, so the natural oscillation frequency will be higher unless large load capacitors are explicitly added.

power_consumption.description: Total power consumed by the VCO core.

sky130_expected.calculation: 4 tail currents of 1mA each = 4mA total. Power = 4mA * 1.8V = 7.2mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical bias currents required to achieve sufficient swing and phase noise in a 130nm ring VCO.

output_amplitude.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing of the oscillator outputs.

sky130_expected.calculation: Swing = I_tail_total * R_load = 2mA * 500 ohm = 1V single-ended peak-to-peak.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A swing of ~1V is typical to fully switch the cross-coupled pairs while keeping transistors in saturation.

phase_error.description: Deviation from the ideal 90-degree phase shift between adjacent quadrature outputs.

sky130_expected.calculation: Ideal is 90 degrees. In a perfectly symmetric simulation, error is 0.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Without mismatch models, the phase difference should be exactly 90 degrees.

phase_noise.description: Phase noise at a specific offset frequency (e.g., 600 kHz).

sky130_expected.calculation: Typical ring VCO phase noise scales with power and frequency.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Comparable to the paper's reported value, adjusted for the higher oscillation frequency in 130nm.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench to measure oscillation frequency, output amplitude, quadrature phase difference, and power consumption of the ring VCO.
